command:
set -euo pipefail; find_pids(){ for e in /proc/[0-9]*/exe; do x=$(readlink "$e" 2>/dev/null || true); case "$x" in /usr/lib/chatgpt/*) basename "$(dirname "$e")";; esac; done; }; BEFORE=$(find_pids | tr '
' ' '); echo "before_pids=${BEFORE:-none}"; if [ -z "$BEFORE" ]; then mkdir -p $HOME/.local/state/omega-desktop; nohup $HOME/.local/bin/omega-chatgpt >$HOME/.local/state/omega-desktop/chatgpt.log 2>&1 </dev/null & fi; sleep 6; PIDS=$(find_pids | tr '
' ' '); echo "after_pids=${PIDS:-none}"; [ -n "$PIDS" ] || { tail -n 50 $HOME/.local/state/omega-desktop/chatgpt.log 2>/dev/null || true; exit 7; }; PID=$(printf '%s' "$PIDS" | awk '{print $1}'); EXE=$(readlink "/proc/$PID/exe"); echo "desktop_exe=$EXE"; if tr '\0' '
' < "/proc/$PID/environ" | grep -q '^OMEGA_MCP_TOKEN='; then echo 'omega_mcp_token_env=PRESENT_REDACTED'; else echo 'omega_mcp_token_env=ABSENT'; exit 8; fi; if tr '\0' '
' < "/proc/$PID/environ" | grep -q '^DISPLAY=:0$'; then echo 'display_binding=PASS_:0'; else echo 'display_binding=NOT_PROVEN'; exit 9; fi
